- TTHeaderStreaming must be dedicated flag = 64, not TTHeader|STREAMING composite
- GRPCStreaming must be dedicated flag = 128, not GRPC|STREAMING composite
- String() must handle composites with pipe-separated names in ascending bit order
- Default protocol must change to Framed

These need correction before claiming completion.
